text:
Roe v. Wade is controversial because it settled a deeply divided moral question, when life begins and what the fetus is owed, through a contested reading of the Due Process Clause that many critics said was weakly reasoned and took the issue out of democratic debate. Supporters saw it as protecting bodily autonomy and women's equality, and the Court overturned it in Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization (2022), returning abortion regulation to the states.
